title: Eventual agreement on balls gives weak convergence, convergence of mass measures and ∂C = 0
statement: Assume measure locality (MEAS, the exact type of dtc_bc_measure_restrict_eq_of_eqOn, taken as a hypothesis): for all P, n, open U₁, U₂, W ⊆ ℝ^P with W ⊆ U₁ ∩ U₂, T₁ ∈ 𝒟_n(U₁), T₂ ∈ 𝒟_n(U₂) and integer multiplicity representations R₁ of T₁, R₂ of T₂, if currentEval T₁ ω = currentEval T₂ ω for every ω ∈ TestFormOn W n then R₁.measure.restrict W = R₂.measure.restrict W. Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U_j ⊆ ℝ^P open (j ∈ ℕ), S_j ∈ 𝒟_n(U_j), and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P). Assume that for every R ∈ ℝ, for all sufficiently large j: B_R(0) ⊆ U_j; currentEval(S_j, ω) = C(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) with tsupport ω ⊆ B_R(0); and ∂S_j(β) = 0 for every β ∈ 𝒟^m(U_j) with tsupport β ⊆ B_R(0). Then S_j ⇀ C in ℝ^P (ConvergesWeakly), μ_{S_j} → μ_C for all integer multiplicity representations (MassMeasuresConverge), and ∂C = 0 (C.boundary = 0).
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U₁ U₂ W : Set (Euclid P)) (T₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U₁ n) (T₂ : GeometricCurrentOn U₂ n) (R₁ : IMRep U₁ n) (R₂ : IMRep U₂ n), IsOpen U₁ → IsOpen U₂ → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U₁ → W ⊆ U₂ → R₁.Represents T₁ → R₂.Represents T₂ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn W n, currentEval T₁ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = currentEval T₂ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) → R₁.measure.restrict W = R₂.measure.restrict W) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Us : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (Ss : (j : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Us j) (m + 1)) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsOpen (Us j)) → (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ball (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ Us j ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball 0 R → currentEval (Ss j) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) = C ω) ∧ ∀ β : TestFormOn (Us j) m, tsupport (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 R → (Ss j).boundary β = 0) → ConvergesWeakly Ss C ∧ MassMeasuresConverge Ss C ∧ C.boundary = 0
